title: hive forget output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive forget NAME --json`. Removes the named entry from the global registry (~/Dev/hive/config.yml). Does not touch the project's .hive-state directory on disk. Idempotency: an unknown name is a USAGE error (64), mirroring `hive metrics --project NAME`, unless --if-exists is passed.

removed.description: true when a registry row was removed; false when --if-exists found the entry already absent.

path.description: Absolute path the removed entry was bound to. Present only when removed is true.

hive_state_path.description: Absolute path of the entry's .hive-state directory (informational; not deleted). Present only when removed is true.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised. Matches every other hive-* error envelope.

error_kind.description: missing_name = NAME positional was empty/whitespace. unknown_project = NAME does not match any registry entry. config = malformed config.yml or missing $HIVE_HOME (exit 78). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 70).
